# Threadline MVP

> MBA AI in Management, Scenario A: supervised order/return support for an Indian D2C apparel store. Current local prototype v0.5 uses a synthetic SQLite source, React/FastAPI, a WhatsApp-style browser simulation and local Qwen3-8B intent routing. Real retailer, WhatsApp, courier and payment integrations are proposed, not connected.

## Start here

- [Complete system guide](https://github.com/presish1/aim-retail-support/blob/main/SYSTEM_GUIDE.md): self-contained explanation, tool boundaries, safety limits and future integration shape.
- [Presentation briefing](https://github.com/presish1/aim-retail-support/blob/main/docs/PRESENTATION_BRIEF.md): team narrative, suggested slides, speaker notes and demo.
- [Documentation map](https://github.com/presish1/aim-retail-support/blob/main/docs/README.md): all current references and historical status.
- [Evidence and FAQ](https://github.com/presish1/aim-retail-support/blob/main/docs/17-evidence-and-faq.md): defined local tests, claims, limitations and learning prompts.

## Reading context

Separate implemented, verified locally, proposed, assumed and historical claims. The code baseline reviewed for these documents is d49563f. Current code and the current reference documents take precedence over earlier prototype/design notes. The original US-store draft assumption is superseded by India/INR/IST.

This index helps locate files; it does not ensure automatic indexing by any reading tool. Fetch the named files or ask for them if unavailable. The MVP is not universally hallucination-free, totally safe, a real WhatsApp integration, a payment executor, or evidence of measured ROI.
